title: Card Expiry Input
summary: Masks a card expiry as MM/YY and reads it back as a date, catching month 13, a year typed first or a card that expires before the next renewal.
description: Masks MM/YY, reads the date back as valid through the month's last day, and catches month 13, the year typed first, a four-digit year, an expired card and one that runs out before the next renewal, with one-tap fixes.
catches: Impossible months (13, 00) and the year typed first
A four-digit year, and YYYY-MM autofill
A card that expires before the next renewal date you pass
Expiries implausibly far in the future (maxYears)
limits: Checks the date only; the issuer decides whether the card is valid
"Today" is the visitor's clock unless you pass `today`
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid when invalid and aria-describedby to an aria-live="polite" status
